QuestInfo.name: [Elodin] Thankful?
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1501001##k looks so sad. Ask her what's wrong.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1501001##k wants you to tell the #b#p1501003##k not to be afraid. You should talk to him before you leave.
QuestInfo.2: You had a nice farewell chat with #b#p1501001##k and the #b#p1501003##k.

0.msg: I guess I should have tried to find his parents right away. Searching all of Elodin would have been better than the mess I made of things.

1.msg: Who knew this little guy's mom was the Shimmer Songbird? That little, yellow fluff ball is going to be one handsome bird when he grows up!

2.msg: I guess their feathers are kind of the same color...

3.msg: At least they've found each other now. Let's hope she can give him the singing instruction he so dearly needs.

4.msg: You played a huge part in all this too, #h0#! Come to think of it, what even brought you to the forest in the first place?

5.msg: I can't believe you waited this long to ask that. A kid in Ellinia heard all that shrieking. Then she saw you in your veil and completely panicked. She's been having nightmares about a witch for days and asked me help.

8.msg: Oh, now I feel terrible. Elodin is normally so serene. But she really should be more careful. It's so dark here that it's very easy to get lost. Please apologize to her for me! There's no need for her to be scared.

9.msg: Maybe you should visit her yourself sometime?

10.msg: Oh, and when you return to Ellinia, would you tell the other fairies I said hello? I'd love it if they visited sometime.

0.msg: Perhaps... Well, I should be going. Be sure to say goodbye to the #p1501003# before you leave.
What? Don't you want to return to Ellinia?
Oh! #h0#! I heard you were leaving. I'll miss you!

1.msg: I wanted you to hear more of my singing.

2.msg: Oh, I wouldn't want you to tire your throat out!! I'll catch you next time!

3.msg: Ha! I understand. Thanks to you, I found my family #eand#n learned to sing!

0.msg: Come visit sometime! I'll sing for you!
